changes: GET /api/v1/org/ai-credits/usage/daily — removed the required property `results/breakdown` from the response with the `200` status

declaredAdvisories.reason: GET /api/v1/org/ai-credits/usage/daily no longer accepts the breakdown query parameter, no longer returns the breakdown property, and always returns billable credits per day by feature; each series is { feature, credits } instead of the former typed value/other/deleted/embeddedViewers/unattributed shapes. The endpoint is org-admin only and answers only for organizations with an AI credit contract. Unknown query parameters are ignored, so during a rolling update an old AI Credits settings tab receives the new shape, its usage chart cannot label the series and the page falls back to the app error state until refresh. This is safe because it is an admin reporting view with no writes and a refresh fully recovers it.

impact.firstPartyOnly: The AI Credits organization settings page is the only client of this operation. During a rolling update an old tab on that page shows the app error state until refresh, and nothing is written or lost.
